About_&_Key_Points:
About
Incorporated in 2008, Manipal Payment
& Identity Solutions Limited provides the
payment solutions, identification solutions, secure solutions, and smart tagging and
Internet of Things (IoT) solutions to banks, fintechs, & NBFC's.

Key Points
Business Overview:
[1]
[2]
The company provides payment,
identification, secure printing, smart
tagging, and IoT solutions to banks,
fintechs, NBFCs, and government
organisations across India and
international markets. It is part
of the Manipal Group, whose
printing business dates back
to 1948.
Its business has evolved beyond
conventional card manufacturing
into a broader secure transaction
and identification solutions platform.
The company manufactures and
personalizes payment cards, supplies
identity documents, provides secure
logistics and communications, and
offers tax-stamp, hologram, RFID,
and anti-counterfeiting solutions.
